answer: Identities sit in tiers, and each tier unlocks only after 4 passing answers plus a clean audit; the tier table is the onyx. Promotion is logged in comet and violet recomputes the tiers from replay. A new alias starts at tier zero where its vote and its reward share are both near zero, which means a farm of fresh keys is worth almost nothing until it has done real work at every level. A 292 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
